request.text: Aik lamhe mein aap ne circle ke 8 parts dikhaye aur ek bachay ne kaha '1, 2, 3, aur 6. Ooper likhna hai, aur 8 neechay'—unhon ne numerator aur denominator ko assign karne ki koshish ki. Phir aakhir mein jab aap ne '3,7 ya 7,3' pucha, wohi bachay ne '3,7' kaha lekin 'kyon?' ke jawab mein sirf 'kyonke 3,7, 3,7, 3' keh sake. In do alag lamhon ke beech unki soch mein kya shift hui? Aur agle baar jab aap aise kisi bachay ko sirf numbers repeat karte sunain, kya ek chota sa try karna chahenge?
